blueprint.name: Deploying F5 License Proxy as an IBM Cloud VSI
blueprint.description: Stand up the F5 License Proxy (FLP) as a standalone IBM Cloud VSI appliance in an existing VPC — no cluster required. BNK installs in other clusters license through it privately over the VPC or a Transit Gateway, so only this appliance needs egress to F5.

outcomes: F5 License Proxy running as a podman pod on an IBM Cloud VSI
Licensing endpoint + root CA published as outputs for consuming clusters
Optional flp-status web UI on an operator floating IP

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. The API key provisions the VSI; region and resource group inherit from it.
An existing IBM Cloud VPC to deploy the appliance into, reachable by the consuming cluster (same VPC, peered, or over a Transit Gateway). The proxy is the only component that needs egress to F5.
The F5 FAR auth tarball and subscription JWT must already be in IBM COS (cos_instance/cos_bucket). The runner reads them from COS — project-local file secrets are not used.

input_summary.label: Deploys
input_summary.value: One VSI appliance (default bx2-4x16, 100 GB boot) running the f5-license-proxy stack — the proxy, Vault and PostgreSQL — as a systemd-managed podman pod.

input_summary.label: Licensing reach
input_summary.value: :8443 is gated to the RFC-1918 ranges by default, because the consuming cluster reaches the proxy privately. The operator floating IP is a management path, not the CWC endpoint.

input_summary.label: Consuming a proxy
input_summary.value: Feed this deployment's external_endpoint + root_ca_b64 outputs into the consuming workspace's bnk.flp.external block.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for the appliance's resource names (e.g. acme-flp).

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region the FLP VSI is created in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: cos_bucket
required.label: COS bucket
required.description: COS bucket holding the FAR supply chain. Blank = bnk-artifacts.

required.name: ssh_private_key_secret
required.label: Ssh private key secret
required.description: Name of the BNK Forge PROJECT SECRET holding the appliance's PRIVATE key, unencrypted. Forge materializes it into the run workspace as a file; it is never passed on the command line. Forge stores the key and cannot prompt, so an encrypted key cannot be used.

required.name: bnkforge_url
required.label: Bnkforge url
required.description: BNK Forge URL to store the credential in.

required.name: bnkforge_password
required.label: Bnkforge password
required.description: BNK Forge password. Passed as an environment variable only, never on the command line.

optional.name: flp_vsi_vpc
optional.label: Existing VPC (ID)
optional.description: ID of an existing VPC to deploy the appliance into — the adopt path. This is what a cluster on a Transit Gateway needs: attach the proxy to a VPC already on that gateway. Leave blank ONLY if you set 'Build the proxy its own VPC' below; roksbnkctl refuses both together, and refuses neither.

optional.name: flp_vsi_create_vpc
optional.label: Build the proxy its own VPC
optional.description: true builds the proxy a VPC, address prefix and public gateway of its own rather than adopting one (roksbnkctl v1.45.0+). This is what lets the proxy be the FIRST thing deployed in an air-gapped estate, with no registry or cluster to borrow a network from. Mutually exclusive with the VPC id above. NOTE: roksbnkctl cannot attach a VPC it creates here to a Transit Gateway, so only clusters inside that VPC can reach the proxy — to serve clusters over a gateway, adopt a VPC already on it.

optional.name: flp_vsi_vpc_name
optional.label: Name for the created VPC
optional.description: Names the VPC built when the option above is true. Blank = flp-vsi-vpc. Ignored on the adopt path.

optional.name: flp_vsi_subnet_cidr
optional.label: Address prefix for the created VPC
optional.description: Address prefix for the VPC built when the option above is true. It must not overlap anything the consuming clusters can already route to — a Transit Gateway silently blackholes one of two overlapping VPCs.

optional.name: flp_vsi_zone
optional.label: Zone
optional.description: Zone for the VSI (e.g. us-south-1). Blank = the region's first zone.

optional.name: flp_vsi_profile
optional.label: VSI profile
optional.description: IBM Cloud instance profile. Blank = bx2-4x16, which meets the FLP's 4 vCPU / 8 GB minimum.

optional.name: flp_vsi_ssh_key
optional.label: SSH key name
optional.description: Name of an existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key to attach, so an operator can inspect or recover the appliance. Blank = no SSH access.

optional.name: flp_vsi_boot_size_gb
optional.label: Boot volume (GB)
optional.description: Boot volume size. Blank = 100, which clears the FLP's >80 GB requirement.

optional.name: flp_vsi_floating_ip
optional.label: Attach an operator floating IP
optional.description: On = attach a floating IP so `flp status` and the :80 web UI work from outside the VPC. It is a management path only — the consuming cluster always reaches the proxy privately.

optional.name: flp_management_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Management allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs permitted to reach the :80 status UI. Blank = 0.0.0.0/0 — the page is read-only and carries no secrets.

optional.name: flp_licensing_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Licensing allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs permitted to reach the :8443 proxy and :22. Blank = the RFC-1918 private ranges.

optional.name: flp_status_image
optional.label: flp-status image
optional.description: Image for the flp-status web UI, e.g. harbor.example.com/bnk-status/flp-status:v1. Blank = no status UI (the proxy still serves :8443).

optional.name: flp_status_registry_host
optional.label: Status image registry host
optional.description: Registry host serving the status image. Only needed when it is a private or self-signed mirror.

optional.name: flp_status_registry_ca_b64
optional.label: Status registry CA (base64)
optional.description: Base64 CA for that registry, dropped into the VSI's certs.d so the status image pull is trusted. Already base64 — it is stored verbatim.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.label: BNK manifest version
optional.description: Manifest release the FLP chart set is resolved from. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR supply chain, used only when the local-file paths are cleared. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: flp_namespace
optional.label: FLP namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace the F5 License Proxy client resources go into. Blank keeps the default the subscription JWT implies.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Resolved from the project's credential template when the project is created. Not entered by hand.

optional.name: flp_vsi_name_prefix
optional.label: Prefix for the appliance's resource names
optional.description: Blank keeps the legacy unprefixed names (flp-vsi, flp-vsi-subnet, …), which is the default so upgrading roksbnkctl does not rename — and therefore REPLACE — a running proxy. Set it if you want a second standalone proxy in this account (the literal names collide otherwise), or so the 'Find/Remove orphaned IBM Cloud resources' blueprints can see this appliance: they sweep by <prefix>-* and an unprefixed flp-vsi is invisible to them. Requires roksbnkctl v1.47.0+.

optional.name: appliance_host
optional.label: Appliance host
optional.description: The address FORGE must reach the appliance on — the FLOATING IP, not the private endpoint the appliance reports. An FLP publishes https://10.243.1.4:8443, which is inside the services VPC that Forge sits outside of, so a credential built from it can never connect. Wired from the flp module's floating_ip output when an flp is in this deployment; set it yourself otherwise, e.g. for a harbor VSI.

optional.name: ssh_username
optional.label: Ssh username
optional.description: SSH user on the appliance. ubuntu for the FLP and Harbor VSI images.

optional.name: credential_name
optional.label: Credential name
optional.description: Name for the credential in Forge. Blank uses <project>-ssh.

optional.name: bnkforge_project
optional.label: Bnkforge project
optional.description: BNK Forge project to attach the credential to. Blank uses this project.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.label: Bnkforge insecure
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate. Prefer bnkforge_ca_b64.

optional.name: bnkforge_ca_b64
optional.label: Bnkforge ca b64
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the CA that issued Forge's certificate, pinning the call.

optional.name: flp_chart_version
optional.label: Flp chart version
optional.description: ChartVersion pins the f5-license-proxy chart. Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.chart_version.

optional.name: flp_node_port_access
optional.label: Flp node port access
optional.description: NodePortAccess exposes the proxy OUTSIDE its own cluster, so a BNK install in a DIFFERENT cluster (same VPC, or across a transit gateway) can licen... Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.node_port_access.

optional.name: flp_node_port_source_cidrs
optional.label: Flp node port source cidrs
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_FLP_NODE_PORT_SOURCE_CIDRS. Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.node_port_source_cidrs[0].

optional.name: flp_storage_class
optional.label: Flp storage class
optional.description: The dynamic StorageClass for the FLP's PVCs (rendered as flp_storage_class). Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.storage_class.

optional.name: flp_vsi_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Flp vsi allowed cidrs
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_FLP_VSI_ALLOWED_CIDRS. Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.vsi.allowed_cidrs[0].

optional.name: flp_vsi_forward_proxy_host
optional.label: Flp vsi forward proxy host
optional.description: The forward proxy's address. Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.vsi.forward_proxy.host.

optional.name: flp_vsi_forward_proxy_port
optional.label: Flp vsi forward proxy port
optional.description: The forward proxy's port. Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.vsi.forward_proxy.port.

optional.name: flp_vsi_forward_proxy_protocol
optional.label: Flp vsi forward proxy protocol
optional.description: http (default) | https Maps to config.yaml bnk.flp.vsi.forward_proxy.protocol.

modules.name: roksbnkctl FLP (VSI)
modules.description: roksbnkctl flp up in vsi mode — a standalone F5 License Proxy appliance in an existing VPC.

modules.name: Register the appliance's SSH key with Forge
modules.description: Stores the appliance's PRIVATE key in Forge and attaches it to the project, so Forge can reach the VSI itself. Optional: skip it and Forge reports infrastructure_access_status recovery_required.
